section.p: The Student Portal is the online self-service page where active students log in to manage their Study Plan (KRS), view Study Result Cards (KHS) and GPA, and track their Thesis and Yudisium progress.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-secondary position-relative
div.h5: Stage 1: Logging In & Opening Your Dashboard
div.p: Log in using your campus email and password, then open My Account (/my/home). From the dashboard you can jump directly to your KRS, KHS, or Thesis pages.

ul.li: You must be logged in to access any portal page; visitors who are not logged in are redirected to the login screen.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-success position-relative
div.h5: Stage 2: Filling Out & Submitting KRS Online

ol.li: Open your active KRS in Draft or Needs Revision status.
Review the list of Available Schedules at the bottom and click Take to add a class (or Remove to drop a selected class).
Once your subjects and total SKS are ready, click Submit KRS to send it to your Academic Advisor (PA).

div.strong: System Rules & Validations (What to do if blocked):

ul.li: Only Editable in Draft / Revision: You cannot add or remove subjects once the KRS is Submitted, Approved, or Locked. If you need changes after submitting, ask your Academic Advisor to return it for revision.
KRS Period Must Be Open: Students can only edit KRS within the active KRS dates. Outside this period, contact Academic Admin.

Automatic Checks on "Take": The portal immediately blocks and shows an alert banner if adding a class exceeds your GPA SKS limit, overlaps with another chosen schedule, has a full classroom, or misses a prerequisite subject.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-primary position-relative
div.p: Open the KHS menu to see your subjects, letter grades, semester GPA (IP), and cumulative GPA (IPK). Grades appear automatically as soon as your lecturer enters them.

div.class: mb-4 ps-4 border-start border-4 border-info position-relative
div.h5: Stage 4: Tracking Thesis & Uploading Yudisium Documents
div.p: Open My Thesis (/my/thesis) to register your thesis, add consultation progress notes, upload Yudisium clearance documents, and download your Graduation Clearance Sheet PDF once approved.

Each student account can only view and edit its own KRS, KHS, and Thesis records. If someone tries to open another student's document link directly, the system automatically blocks access so personal academic records stay private.
